intro: IBPS Clerk prelims cutoffs are set state by state, so there is no single national figure. The series below shows the middle value (median) across all states for the UR category, which tells you how hard each year was overall. Your own state's cutoff can sit far from the median.

series.label: Prelims cutoff, UR, median across states (out of 100)

factors: State-wise vacancies and the number of candidates applying for that state.
The paper's difficulty. The median fell sharply in 2025, a reminder that one year does not predict the next.
Sectional cutoffs. A good total does not help if any one test is below its minimum.
caveat: The median across states hides large differences between states, so look up your own state in the cutoff page before you decide on a target.
target: Look at your state's UR cutoff for the last two cycles on the cutoffs page and aim a few marks above the higher one.
